TransferDesc: Transfer login information and registration information to a new device
ExportDesc: You can export PeaSyo configuration locally for future configuration recovery and transfer to another device, without the need to re-login or register hosts.
ExportTips: The exported file keeps the .json extension, but the content is encrypted so it can be exchanged with the mobile app.
ImportDesc: If you have a PeaSyo configuration file, you can import it directly without re-login or re-registering hosts.
The app will restart after import succee: The app will restart automatically after import succeeds.
Manage signed in PSN accounts here. Newl: Manage signed in PSN accounts here. Newly added accounts become the current account immediately. Registered hosts are kept when deleting accounts.
Delete the selected account? Registered: Delete the selected account? Registered hosts will be kept on this device.
Gamepad input kernel desc: Switch between Web kernel and Native kernel for gamepad input. Native kernel uses native SDL input and is recommended for lower latency.
FeedbackDesc: Join the community group to share issues and suggestions
These settings apply to the next stream: These settings apply to the next stream session. Local and remote profiles are saved separately.
Set resolution, support 360P/540P/720P/1: Set the streaming resolution, supports switching between 360P/540P/720P/1080P
RemoteResolutionDesc: Set the remote streaming resolution, supports switching between 360P/540P/720P/1080P
Select video stream format, if you want: Select video stream format, if you want video fullscreen, please select Stretch or Zoom
BitrateDesc: Set the maximum streaming bitrate. Note that PS4/PS5 streaming bitrate is dynamic.
BitrateTips: Using a bitrate that is too high may cause video artifacts. If this happens, lower the bitrate.
RemoteBitrateDesc: Set the maximum remote streaming bitrate. Note that PS4/PS5 streaming bitrate is dynamic.
CodecDesc: Set the video playback codec. H264 uses AVC decoding, H265 uses HEVC decoding.
LinuxHdrDisabledHint: On Linux/SteamOS, HDR is currently ineffective. Selecting H265-HDR will automatically fall back to H265 during streaming.
RemoteCodecDesc: Set the remote video playback codec. H264 uses AVC decoding, H265 uses HEVC decoding.
If your device supports newer codecs, it: If your device supports newer codecs, it can reduce the video bandwidth requirements
RemoteFPSDesc: Set the remote streaming frame rate
Set the host streaming bitrate (Note: Hi: Set the host streaming bitrate (Note: Higher bitrate is not always better; the final bitrate will be determined by streaming negotiation)
Set the cloud streaming bitrate (Note: H: Set the cloud streaming bitrate (Note: Higher bitrate is not always better; the final bitrate will be determined by streaming negotiation)
If your controller supports vibration, y: If your controller supports vibration, you can set whether it vibrates during the game
trigger_rumble_description: Force controller trigger rumbled(Only work in Xbox one/s/x controller)
Automatic bitrate will follow the select: Automatic bitrate will follow the selected resolution and use {{bitrate}} kbps.
Press a key to bind it. Press Backspace: Press a key to bind it. Press Backspace to clear the current binding.
Please press the button on the controlle: Please press the button on the controller, which will be mapped to:
After successful mapping, this pop-up wi: After successful mapping, this pop-up will automatically close
If your joystick's maximum value doesn't: If your joystick's maximum value doesn't reach the expected level, you can set maximum value compensation
power_on_description: Choose whether to power on the console when streaming. By default, the console remains in sleep mode, and the power light won't turn on during streaming. Enabling this option will fully power on the host and may wake up the monitor
Gamepad_mix_desc: Enable this option if you want inputs from multiple gamepads to be merged
Audio_volume_desc: If the default maximum volume does not meet your expectations, you can choose to amplify the audio source here (Note: excessive volume may affect your hearing!)
native_mouse_keyboard_desc: Some games support native keyboard and mouse operation, you can enable this option
mouse_sensitive_desc: After enabling native keyboard and mouse, if the mouse sensitivity doesn't meet expectations, you can adjust the mouse sensitivity
background_keepalive_desc: Whether keepalive input when app is in background(This feature is not available on Windows)
value_vulkan_desc: Enabling Vulkan rendering can improve rendering performance on some devices, but may lead to instability (such as black screen, etc.)
Stream renderer desc: Choose the video decode and render pipeline used for Remote Play. FFmpeg uses the existing rawvideo path. WebCodec uses the browser-native decoder and renderer.
SteamOS WebCodec profile desc: Applies only when Stream renderer is WebCodec. Higher stability profiles increase buffering and latency to reduce tearing/flicker on SteamOS.
FSR_desc: Enable FSR (FidelityFX Super Resolution) to achieve super-resolution, which can improve image clarity without increasing bandwidth, but will increase CPU/GPU load
